periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique angle approximately 45 degrees downward and outward relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a high vertical-to-horizontal ratio along the primary diagonal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering resulting in a teardrop profile where the bulk of the pigment mass sits below the ocular center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad U-shaped profile along the posterior edge with no sharp V-shaped indentation.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, occupying approximately one-third of the visible upper-torso area.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation with a cranial gap significantly larger than the width of the individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, continuous semi-circular curvature at the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced chromatic contrast between the bright white facial fur and the yellowish-beige tint of the ventral abdominal fur.
